title: Phillygenin inhibited LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cell inflammation by NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Zhou, Mengting; Tang, Yunqiu; Liao, Li; Liu, Meichen; Deng, Ying; Zhao, Xingtao; Li, Yunxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木脂素成分Phillygenin通过NF-kappaB通路抑制LPS诱导的巨噬细胞炎症，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白亲和力评估，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is a common pathological phenomenon when homeostasis is seriously disturbed. Phillygenin (PHI), a lignin component isolated from Forsythiae Fructus, has shown a good anti-inflammatory effect. However, the mechanisms of PHI on anti-inflammation have not yet been systematically elucidated. In this study, the lipopolysaccharide (LPS) - induced RAW264.7 cell inflammation model was established to investigate mechanisms of PHI on inflammation. The effect of PHI on the release of IL-1beta and PGE2 inflammatory factors induced by LPS was detected by ELISA, and the mRNA expressions of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha were detected by RT-qPCR. Proteomics studied the signaling pathways that might be affected by PHI and molecular docking technology was subsequently used to study the possible targets on proteomic screened pathways. Western blot was performed ultimately to detect progressive changes in protein expression on the related pathway. Our research showed that PHI significantly inhibited the robust increase of IL-1beta and PGE2 and lowered the transcriptional level of inflammatory genes including IL-6, IL-1beta and PGE2 in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells. Proteomics results indicated that PHI was involved in the regulation of multiple signaling pathways. Molecular docking results indicated that PHI had an affinity for most proteins in NF-kappaB pathway. Western blot analysis proved that PHI inhibited LPS-induced NF-kappaB pathway activation. On the whole, PHI inhibited the activation of NF-kappaB pathway, thereby inhibiting the expression of related inflammatory genes and the release of cytokines, and showed a remarkable anti-inflammatory effect.
abstract_zh: 炎症是体内稳态受到严重干扰时常见的病理现象。从连翘果实中分离得到的木脂素成分连翘脂素（Phillygenin, PHI）显示出良好的抗炎作用。然而，PHI抗炎的作用机制尚未被系统阐明。本研究建立脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的RAW264.7细胞炎症模型，以探讨PHI对炎症的作用机制。通过ELISA检测PHI对LPS诱导的IL-1β和PGE2炎症因子释放的影响，并通过RT-qPCR检测IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的mRNA表达。蛋白质组学研究PHI可能影响的信号通路，随后采用分子对接技术研究蛋白质组筛选通路上的可能靶点。最终通过Western blot检测相关通路蛋白表达的渐进变化。我们的研究表明，PHI显著抑制LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中IL-1β和PGE2的急剧增加，并降低包括IL-6、IL-1β和PGE2在内的炎症基因的转录水平。蛋白质组学结果表明，PHI参与多个信号通路的调控。分子对接结果表明，PHI对NF-κB通路中的大多数蛋白质具有亲和力。Western blot分析证明，PHI抑制LPS诱导的NF-κB通路激活。总体而言，PHI抑制NF-κB通路的激活，从而抑制相关炎症基因的表达和细胞因子的释放，表现出显著的抗炎作用。
